title: Corrective fix for B-4fcfc7b9: Review cook mode feature integration
description:
Blocked reason: CookModeDonePage (CookModeStepView.swift:157) does not suppress the parent NavigationStack toolbar's Close button. The design decision states explicitly: CookModeDonePage hides the nav bar controls and presents its own Done button. Fix: add .toolbar(.hidden, for: .navigationBar) to CookModeDonePage.body or as a view modifier on the struct's view return. Both buttons currently dismiss the cover identically, so there is no functional regression, but the deviation from the documented design decision must be resolved before sign-off.

Remaining work: One finding requires a corrective fix: CookModeDonePage must suppress the navigation bar (add .toolbar(.hidden, for: .navigationBar)) so that only the in-page Done button is visible on the completion page, matching the stated design decision. Administrative: spec file should be moved from drafts to done once the corrective is resolved.
